children: NutriBand announced that its publicly traded warrants (NTRBW) will expire at 5:00 p.m. ET on September 30, 2026.
Warrants (Nasdaq: NTRBW) expire automatically at 5:00 p.m. Eastern on September 30, 2026 per the Warrant Agreement.
Trading in the warrants will cease at market close on September 30, 2026, then warrants will be removed from Nasdaq.
Any unexercised warrants at expiration will be void and have no further value to holders.
The expiration does not affect NutriBand common stock, which will continue trading on Nasdaq under NTRB.
